description: Screen whether a license covers an intended use for a clip and which tier fits: commercial, editorial, documentary, internal_corporate, digital (web and social), broadcast, theatrical, or ai_training. Reports chain of title, people and property flags, and the release policy. Catalog screening, not legal advice.

expected_distribution.description: Optional expected views or copies. Above 1,000,000 needs the Extended license.

intended_use.description: Intended use: commercial, editorial, documentary, internal_corporate, digital, broadcast, theatrical, or ai_training. Default commercial. AI training needs a separate data license.
